column36: A statewide rule, like window A's Pennsylvania model: it binds each Maryland electric company's own large load tariff. Status: published as proposed on 26 June 2026 with comments to 27 July 2026; whether the PSC has since adopted it was not verified (a later Maryland Register issue would show the final action). Each investor-owned company had to file its own large load rate schedule by 1 September 2026: Chapter 353 (HB 1532, signed 12 May 2026), Public Utilities 4-212(c)(1)(i), p.34 of the session law: 'On or before September 1, 2026, each investor-owned electric company and each electric cooperative shall submit to the Commission for approval a specific rate schedule for large load customers'.
